record.paper_title: Approximating network dynamics: Some open problems
record.original_question: For the same class N of synchronous finite-state neuronal networks, determine the typical dynamics, including attractor behavior, transient behavior, and phase transitions, when the random connectivity is not a single-type Erdős-Rényi digraph but instead a multitype Erdős-Rényi random digraph, a generic scale-free network, or a small-world network.

evidence.quote: It is of interest to study the dynamics of N for other types of random connectiv- ities, such as multitype Erd˝ os-R´ enyi random digraphs, generic scale-free networks, and small-world networks. Research on these questions is currently ongoing [21].

artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open research direction concerning dynamics of synchronous finite-state neuronal networks under multitype Erdős–Rényi, scale-free, and small-world random connectivities. No conclusive published resolution covering all three regimes was located; related work on sparse Erdős–Rényi neuronal networks exists, but the multitype/scale-free/small-world cases appear to remain ongoing research.

status_evidence.claim: Listed as an ongoing open problem regarding alternative random connectivities.
